verdict.rationale: Channel3's own agentic search mode hands query planning to a built-in LLM, which extracts filters and splits requests into sub-searches. That is a narrow form of delegating a task to an in-product AI, but it is limited to search planning, not a general assistant. Its MCP, UCP, SDK and CLI integrations connect external agents rather than providing a built-in one, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose built-in assistant that accepts and carries out delegated tasks beyond search planning, multi-step task execution, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of agentic mode.
